assessments.subject: Physics

sampleItems.stem: A train is moving along a straight horizontal track at a constant speed of $20\text{ m/s}$. A passenger sitting inside the train carriage places a book on their tray table. Which of the following statements correctly describes the state of motion of the book?

An object starts at position $x = +5\text{ m}$ on a one-dimensional coordinate axis. It moves along the axis to $x = +15\text{ m}$, turns back, and moves to $x = -2\text{ m}$. What are the total distance traveled and the net displacement of the object during this motion?

A runner moves along a straight $x$-axis in the positive direction from $x = 0$ to $x = +100\text{ m}$ in $40\text{ s}$, then turns around and runs in the negative direction from $x = +100\text{ m}$ to $x = +70\text{ m}$ in $10\text{ s}$. Calculate the magnitude of the runner's average velocity and the runner's average speed over the entire $50\text{ s}$ interval, in $\text{m/s}$. Enter the magnitude of average velocity first, followed by average speed, separated by a comma (e.g., 2.3, 3.4).
